description.value:
You touch a droid or construct and enhance one of its systems, choosing one of the following benefits, which lasts until the power ends:

Servomotor. Advantage on Strength checks and doubled carrying capacity.

Motivator. Advantage on Dexterity checks, and immunity to falling damage from falls of 20 feet or less while not incapacitated.

Power Core. Advantage on Constitution checks and 2d6 temporary hit points, lost when the power ends.

Databanks. Advantage on Intelligence checks.

Sensors. Advantage on Wisdom checks.

Relations Protocols. Advantage on Charisma checks.

Cast with a tech slot of 3rd level or higher, you can affect one additional droid or construct for each slot level above 2nd.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 2
